headline: Councilor Lydia King's proposed rooftop wind ordinance, plus subcommittee updates on communications, plug-in solar, and native plantings.
summary: Kyle Davis will give the city council liaison update. The Sustainability and Resiliency Department will also report on its recent work, and residents can offer public comment.
items: Guest speaker Councilor Lydia King on her proposed rooftop wind ordinance
Old/new business: subcommittee updates on Communications (Leigh Chandler, Kevin Rice, John Hayes), Plug-In Solar (Bill Burns, John Hayes), and Native Plantings (Kevin Rice)
Upcoming city committee meeting agendas, found at the Boards & Commissions Agenda Center

meeting may do so in the following manner: 
Remote Participation Instructions
Join online: Microsoft Teams meeting

During portions of the meeting in which public comment is permitted, members of the public

dialing in may press “*9” to raise their hand to speak.
